q: Chapal has made tea. Make it passive voice.

Tea was being made by Chapal
Tea has been made by Chapal
Tea have been made by Chapal

Zainul Abedin painted this picture

q: What is the correct passive form of the sentence: ' Shirley paid the bill '?

q: The correct passive form of the sentence 'they laugh at us' is ----?

we are laughed at with them

we are laughed at by them

A promise should be kept

One's promise should be kept by himself

source: জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহকারী রাজস্ব কর্মকর্তা(মুক্তিযোদ্ধা ও ক্ষুদ্র নৃগোষ্ঠী) : ২০১৫

source: বাংলাদেশ ক্ষুদ্র ও কুটির শিল্প করপোরেশনঃ ১৩- ১৬তম গ্রেড এর কর্মচারী ২০১৯/ প্রাক-প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় সহকারী শিক্ষক নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা ২০১৫/ সমাজকল্যাণ মন্ত্রণালয়ের অধীন সমাজসেবা অধিদপ্তরের সমাজসেবা অফিসারঃ ০৬

source: ২৬তম বিসিএস/ পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের প্রশাসনিক কর্মকর্তাঃ ০৪/সড়ক ও জনপথ অধিদপ্তরের উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী (সিভিল): ০৩

q: Identify the correct passive form: Open the window –
options: The window should be opened
Let the window be opened

explain: Imperative বাক্যটি আদেশ বোঝাচ্ছে, যার প্যাসিভ স্ট্রাকচার: Let + object + be + V3।
source: ২৩তম বিসিএস/ বাংলাদেশ কেমিক্যাল ইন্ডাস্ট্রিজ সহকারী প্রকৌশলী (কমার্শিয়াল)-২১/ বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ মেইল অপারেটর/ স্টেনো টাইপিস্ট কাম কম্পিউটার অপারেটর/ নিম্নমান সহকারী কাম কম্পিউটার ২০১৯/মাধ্যমিক ও উচ্চ শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তরের হিসাব সহকারী ২০১৩/ প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় প্রধান শিক্ষক-০৯

source: প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় সহকারী শিক্ষক নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা (করতোয়া) : ২০১০

source: খাদ্য অধিদপ্তরের অফিস সহকারী কাম কম্পিউটার মুদ্রাক্ষরিক : ২০১৩

Tea should be taken by us

q: Who gave you this pen ? বাক্যেটির Passive form হচ্ছে -----?
options: By whom were you got this pen ?
By whom were you given this pen ?
By whom was you given this pen ?
By whom have you been given this pen ?
explain: Past Indefinite ইন্টারোগেটিভ: By whom + were (you-এর জন্য) + subject (you) + V3 (given) + object (this pen)?
source: রেজিস্টার্ড বেসরকারি প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা (গোলাপ) : ২০১১

q: 'He is going to set up a school' বাক্যটির সঠিক পরিবর্তিত voice হবে ?

A school is being set up by him
A school is gone to be set up by him
A school has been going to be set up by him

source: প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় প্রধান শিক্ষক নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা(পদ্ম) : ২০০৯

q: I knew him. Make it passive voice .
options: He is known to me
He was known by me
He was known to me
He was known with me

q: The passive form of the sentence “Do the task as directed” is ---
options: let the task be done as directed.
let the task to be done as directed.
let the task is done as directed.
do the task to be directed.

source: শিক্ষা প্রকৌশল অধিদপ্তর উপ সহকারী প্রকৌশলী (ইলেকট্রিক্যাল)-২১

q: Change the voice of ‘I don't know him’.
options: He is not known by me
He is not known me.
He is not know me
He is not known to me.

q: Which one is the correct passive voice ?
options: Two criminals were arrested and one released.
Two criminals were arrested and one was released.
Two criminals arrested and one was released.
Two criminals arrested and one released.
explain: বাক্যটিতে দুটি পৃথক সাবজেক্ট (Two criminals এবং one) রয়েছে। Compound sentence-এ দুটি অংশের সাবজেক্ট ভিন্ন হলে উভয়ের সাথেই যথাযথ auxiliary verb বসাতে হয়। প্রথম অংশে plural হওয়ায় 'were' এবং দ্বিতীয় অংশে singular হওয়ায় 'was' বসবে।

q: A Passive Voice of 'You can help us’
options: We can be help by you
We could be helped by you
We can be helped by you.
We are helped by you
explain: Modal auxiliary (can, could, may, might ইত্যাদি) যুক্ত বাক্যকে Passive করার নিয়ম হলো: Object + modal + be + V3 + by + subject। এখানে 'us' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'We' হয়েছে এবং can-এর পর 'be helped' বসেছে।
source: বাংলাদেশ কেমিক্যাল ইন্ডাস্ট্রিজ কর্পোরেশন; সহকারী প্রকৌশলী (কমার্শিয়াল)-২১/ বাংলাদেশ কেমিক্যাল ইন্ডাস্ট্রিজ কর্পোরেশন; উপ-সহকারী প্রকৌশলী (মেকানিক্যাল)-২১

q: Choose the best alternative to complete the sentence : A new house ---- at the corner of the road.
options: been built
is being built
is building
building
explain: বাড়ি নিজে নিজে তৈরি হতে পারে না, তাই বাক্যটি Passive ফর্মে হবে। 'is being built' দ্বারা বর্তমান সময়ে বাড়িটি তৈরি করা হচ্ছে এমন অর্থ প্রকাশ পায়। 'is building' একটি active গঠন যা এখানে অর্থহীন।
source: রাজশাহী কৃষি উন্নয়ন ব্যাংক সিনিয়র অফিসার : ২০১০

q: 'They elected him captain ' বাক্যের Passive form হচ্ছে -----?
options: He has been elected captain by them
He elected captain by them
He was elected captain by them
He is elected captain by them
explain: এটি Past Indefinite Tense-এর উদাহরণ। Passive করার নিয়ম: Object (him) -> He + was/were + V3 (elected) + extension (captain) + by + them। তাই সঠিক উত্তর 'He was elected captain by them'।

q: 'She' fans herself' বাক্যের Passive form হচ্ছে ---
options: She was fanned by herself
She is fanned herself
She is fanned by herself
She was fanned herself
explain: Reflexive object (myself, herself, himself ইত্যাদি) যুক্ত active voice-কে passive করার সময় subject অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। নিয়ম: Subject + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb + V3 + by + reflexive object।

q: You must do the work. Change the sentence in passive voice.
options: The work will be done by you.
The work must be done by you.
The work has been done by you.
You will do the work.
explain: Modal auxiliary 'must' থাকলে passive করার সময় 'must be' + verb-এর past participle (done) বসে।
source: আইন, বিচার ও সংসদ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয়ের সাব-রেজিস্ট্রার : ২০১২

q: Who taught you English ? বাক্যের Passive form হচ্ছে -----?
options: By whom were you taught English ?
By whom had you been taught English ?
By whom had you taught English ?
By whom was you taught English ?
explain: 'Who' দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া interrogative বাক্যকে passive করার সময় 'By whom' বসে। এরপর tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb (were) + object (you) + V3 (taught) + বাকি অংশ বসে।
source: প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় সহকারী শিক্ষক নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা (করতোয়া) : ২০১২

q: 'Solve this problem ' বাক্যেটির Passive form হবে -----?
options: The problem is solved by you.

You are solved with the problem.

explain: Imperative sentence-কে passive করার নিয়ম: Let + object + be + V3। সেই অনুযায়ী 'Let the problem be solved' সঠিক।

q: Choose the correct passive voice of the following sentence: 'All of his friend laughted at him'
options: He laughted at all of his friends
He was laughted at by all of his friends.

All of his friends were laughted at him.
explain: Group verb বা preposition যুক্ত verb (laughed at) passive voice-এ একসাথে থাকে। বাক্যটি Past Indefinite হওয়ায় 'was laughed at' সঠিক গঠন।
source: শ্রম ও কর্মসংস্থান মন্ত্রণালয়ের সহকারী পরিচালক : ২০০৫

q: Identify the correct passive form of ' He did not tell the dangerous secrect to anybody '

The dangerious secret was told not him to anybody.
explain: Past Indefinite-এর negative বাক্যকে passive করার সময় was not/were not + V3 ব্যবহৃত হয়। এখানে 'The dangerous secret' object হিসেবে সামনে এসেছে।
source: তথ্য মন্ত্রণালয়ের গণযোগাযোগ প্রশিক্ষণের সহকারী পরিচালক : ২০০১

source: স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের অধীন কারা অধিদপ্তরের কারা তত্ত্বাবধায়ক : ২০১০

q: Select the correct passive form of-- ‘We insist on punctuality in this office.’

explain: Active voice-এ preposition থাকলে (insist on) passive করার সময়ও সেই preposition ধরে রাখতে হয়। Present Indefinite হওয়ায় am/is/are + V3 + preposition ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।
source: খাদ্য অধিদপ্তর নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা (সহকারী উপ-খাদ্য পরিদর্শক) -২১

q: Identify the right passive voice of ‘it is impossible to do this’

source: খাদ্য অধিদপ্তর নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা (অফিস সহকারী কাম কম্পিউটার মুদ্রাক্ষরিক) -২১

q: Trees are considered one of our best friends (Make it active)

q: By whom ......?

the glass was broken
did the glass break

Would they be known by you?
Are they known to you?
explain: 'Know' verb-এর পর passive voice-এ 'by' বসে না, বরং 'to' ব্যবহৃত হয়। তাই 'Are they known to you?' সঠিক।
source: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর (হিসাব সহকারী/ অফিস সহকারী কাম কম্পিউটার অপারেটর)-২১

q: The passive form of 'He pleases us –

We are pleased with him.
We are pleased by him.
We will be pleased by him.
explain: Present Indefinite Tense এবং 'please' verb-এর পর passive voice-এ preposition হিসেবে 'with' ব্যবহৃত হয়।
source: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর (ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং কলেজ এর ক্যাশ সরকার/অফিস সহায়ক) -২১

q: Change into passive : Did he do his task ?

Was his task done by him?
Had his task been done by him?
Was his task being done by him?
explain: Past Indefinite Interrogative-এর passive গঠন: Was/Were + object + V3 + by + him।

q: The sentence which is not expressing any passive sense.

I got fired yesterday.

source: সমন্বিত ৭ ব্যাংক এবং আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান (সিনিয়র অফিসার)-২১

q: Change into passive voice: 'People believe he is a scholar'
options: He is believed scholar by the people.
He is believed to be a scholar
He is a scholar as people believe.
He is being believed a scholar.

source: সমন্বিত ৭ ব্যাংক ও ১ আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান (সিনিয়র অফিসার)-২১

q: The passive voice of: Who is John inviting ?
options: Who is being invited by John?
Who is invited by John?
Whom is invites by John?
Is someone invited by John?
explain: 'Who' সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে থাকলে এবং বাক্যটি Continuous হলে passive-এ 'Who + is/are + being + V3' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

q: A group of bats is called-
options: Pace
Gang
Flock
Colony
explain: এটি একটি Collective Noun-এর প্রশ্ন। বাদুড়ের দলকে ইংরেজিতে 'Colony' বলা হয়।

q: Change the voice: They are going to sell the market.
options: The market is going to be sold by them.
The market is being gone to sell by them
The market is being gone to be sold by them
The market is gone to be sold by them
explain: 'going to' যুক্ত বাক্যকে passive করার নিয়ম: Object + am/is/are + going to be + V3 + by + subject।

q: Passive voice of 'If you're doing something important, you are working to make change happen.'
options: If something important is done, work is done to make change happen.
Something important is being done by you, you are making change happen.
If something important is being done, work is being done to make change happen
If important work is being done, change is about to happen

q: What is the active voice of - 'What she thinks was known to us ?
options: We knew what she thinks
We have known about her thinking
We knew what she is thinking
We know what she thinks
explain: Passive বাক্যে 'was known' থাকলে Active-এ তা Past Indefinite Tense (knew) হয়। 'Known to us' এর Active সাবজেক্ট হবে 'We'।
source: সমন্বিত ৬ ব্যাংক ও আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান (সিনিয়র অফিসার)-২১

q: The passive Voice of “I saw him leaving the house” is

q: The passive voice of “None likes him” is—
options: He is not liked by anyone.

He has not been liked by anyone.
He is liked by none.

q: When i am alone, I hear the footsteps of my friend in my imagination.
options: The footsteps of my friend heard by me, when I am alone.
The footsteps of my friend is heard by me when I am alone.
The footsteps of my friend are heard by me when I am alone.
The footsteps of my friend was heard by me when I am alone.
explain: এখানে অবজেক্ট হলো 'The footsteps' (Plural)। তাই Passive করার সময় Plural auxiliary verb 'are' বসবে এবং মূল ভার্বের Past Participle (heard) হবে।

q: Movies are not watched by him.
options: He did not watch movies
He do not watch movies
He does not watch movies
He is not watched movies
explain: এটি একটি Passive বাক্য যা Present Indefinite Tense-এ আছে। Active করার সময় সাবজেক্ট 'He' (Third Person Singular) হওয়ায় negative ফর্মে 'does not watch' ব্যবহৃত হবে।

q: Change the voice of the sentence- She will invite me.
options: I shall be invited by her.
I will invited by her.
I shall being invited by her.
I will been invited by her.
explain: Future Indefinite Tense-এর Passive রূপ হলো: Subject + shall be/will be + V3। 'I' এর সাথে সাধারণত 'shall be' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

q: The passive form of the sentence ‘You should not scold the boy’ is-
options: The boy should not be scold by you
The boy should not have been scold by you

The boy should not have been scolded by you.
explain: Modal Auxiliary (should) থাকলে Passive করার সময় 'should be' + V3 বসে। যেহেতু বাক্যটি নেতিবাচক, তাই 'should not be scolded' হবে।
source: তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি অধিদপ্তরে সহকারী প্রোগ্রামার ২০২০

q: What is the passive voice of “Who did this” ?

Whom did this?

explain: Interrogative বাক্যে 'Who' থাকলে Passive-এ 'By whom' বসে। Past Indefinite Tense হওয়ায় auxiliary হিসেবে 'was' বসবে।
source: মাদকদ্রব্য নিয়ন্ত্রণ অধিদপ্তরের সহকারী প্রসিকিউটর পদে নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা-২০২০

Whenever I said something, I was never understood by her.
explain: মূল ক্লজ 'She never understood me' Past Indefinite-এ আছে। এর Passive হবে 'I was never understood by her'।
source: জীবন বীমা কর্পোরেশনের অধীনে সহকারী ম্যানেজার পদে নিয়োগ পরীক্ষা-২০২০

source: বিদ্যুৎ, জ্বালানি ও খনিজ সম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয়: সিকিউরিটি অফিসার ২০১৯

q: Trees are considered one of our best friends. (Make it active) off:

q: 'Medha was writing a letter'

A letter was written by Medha.

q: Why is a noise made ?

q: When the telephone invented ?

is

had been
explain: টেলিফোন অতীতে আবিষ্কৃত হয়েছে এবং বাক্যটি Passive voice-এ হবে (টেলিফোন নিজে আবিষ্কৃত হয় না)। তাই Past Indefinite Passive অনুযায়ী 'was' বসবে।
source: বিদ্যুৎ, জ্বালানি ও খনিজ সম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয়: সিকিউরিটি অফিসার ২০১৯

q: Who will----by you ?
options: have been helped
is helped
be helped
is helped
explain: Future Indefinite-এর Passive interrogative-এ 'will + be + V3' ব্যবহৃত হয়। তাই 'be helped' সঠিক।

q: The concert was — by an hour.
options: delayed
cancelled
presented
repeated
explain: অর্থগতভাবে 'delayed' (বিলম্বিত হওয়া) শব্দটি এখানে সবচেয়ে মানানসই। 'এক ঘণ্টা বিলম্বিত হয়েছে' বোঝাতে Passive ফর্মে এটি ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।
source: বাংলাদেশ ফলিত পুষ্টি গবেষণা ও প্রশিক্ষণ ইনস্টিটিউট – ২০১৯

q: I wanted the poster to-
options: hang
to be hanged
to be hungad
to be hung
explain: কোনো বস্তু ঝোলানোর ক্ষেত্রে 'hang' এর V3 হলো 'hung'। Passive infinitive-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী 'to be hung' হবে। (Hanged মানে ফাঁসিতে ঝোলানো)।

q: The house is building. The passive form is--
options: A house is being built by us.
The masons are building the house.
It is the house which is being built.
The house is being built.
explain: কিছু বাক্য Quasi-passive হয়। 'The house is building' মানে হলো ঘরটি নির্মিত হচ্ছে, যার প্রমিত Passive রূপ 'The house is being built'।

q: “Do you know him?” বাক্যটির Passive form হবে-
options: Is he known by you?
Is he known to you ?
Does he known by you?
Is he known with you?
explain: 'Know' ভার্বের পর 'to' বসে এবং Interrogative হিসেবে Auxiliary verb 'Is' শুরুতে বসবে।

q: His behaviour surprised me' - Passive form হবে-
options: I surprised at his behaviour.
I was surprised with his behaviour.
I was surprised at his behaviour.
I has been surprised at his behaviour.
explain: Past Indefinite-এ 'was + V3' বসে এবং 'surprise' এর পর আচরণের ক্ষেত্রে Preposition 'at' বসে।

q: 'Don't do it' is-
options: Let not it be done
Let it be not done
Let it be done
Let it not be done
explain: Negative Imperative-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী 'Let not + object + be + V3' অথবা 'Let + object + not + be + V3' ব্যবহৃত হয়। এখানে অপশন ৪ প্রমিত।

q: ‘That house was built ten years ago’ is –
options: Someone built the house ten years ago.
We had built the house ten years ago
Somebody had built the house ten years ago.
They built the house ten years ago.
explain: এটি Past Indefinite Passive-এ আছে। Active করার সময় অনির্দিষ্ট সাবজেক্ট 'Someone' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে এবং ভার্বের Past form 'built' বসেছে।

q: 'Let it be done'. Is –
options: do it.
Let me do it.
I have done it.
It is done by me.
explain: Imperative Passive (Let... be done) এর Active রূপ সরাসরি 'Verb + Object' হয়। তাই 'Do it' সঠিক।

q: The unfed should be fed. (Active)
options: Feed the unfed
We should feed the unfed.
Please feed the unfed.
They should be feeding the unfed.
explain: Passive-এ 'should be + V3' থাকলে Active-এ 'should + V1' বসে। এখানে সাধারণ উপদেশ বোঝাতে সাবজেক্ট 'We' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

q: The passive form of the sentence “You made him cook rice” is —
options: He was made to cook rice.
He was made cook rice.
He is made to cook rice.
He had made to cook rice.
explain: Causative verb বা Bare Infinitive যুক্ত বাক্যে Passive-এ মূল ভার্বের পর 'to' বসাতে হয়। তাই 'was made to cook' সঠিক।

q: 'I have killed the bird' is –
options: The bird have been killed by me.
The bird has been being killed by me.
The bird has killed by me.
The bird has been killed by me.
explain: Present Perfect Tense-এর Passive structure: Object + has been/have been + V3। 'The bird' যেহেতু Singular, তাই 'has been killed' বসবে।

q: I have written a letter.
options: A letter is being written by me.
A letter has being written by me.
A letter has been written by me.
A letter was being written by me.
explain: এটি Present Perfect Tense, যার Passive রূপ হলো 'has been written'।

q: I saw him fall from the tree' is -
options: He was seen by me to fall from the tree
The tree was seen to fall by me.
He was seen to fall from the tree by me
He was seen falling from the tree by me.
explain: Bare infinitive 'fall' এর আগে Passive voice-এ 'to' ব্যবহৃত হবে। 'Him' অবজেক্টটি 'He' সাবজেক্ট হয়ে যাবে।

q: Whom do you want ?
options: Whom is wanted by you?
By whom are you wanted?
Who is wanted by you?
By whom you are wanted?
explain: Interrogative-এ 'Whom' থাকলে Passive-এ 'Who' বসে। Present Indefinite অনুযায়ী 'is + V3' হবে।

q: Identify the correct passive form of 'He made me laugh’.
options: I was made laugh by him.
I was made to laugh by him.
I was made laughing with him.
I was made laughing by him.
explain: 'Make' ভার্বের পর Active-এ 'to' না থাকলেও Passive-এ 'to' বসাতে হয়। তাই 'was made to laugh' সঠিক।

q: Who is creating this mess ?
options: Who has been created this mess?
By whom has this mess been created?
By whom this mess is being created?
By whom is this mess being created?
explain: Present Continuous-এর ইন্টারোগেটিভ নিয়ম: By whom + am/is/are + object + being + V3? তাই অপশন ৪ সঠিক।

q: “Please keep quiet.”
options: You are told for keep quiet.
You are requested to keep quiet.
You are requested for keep quiet.
You are told to keep quiet.
explain: অনুরোধমূলক (Please) Imperative বাক্যে Passive করার সময় 'You are requested to' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

q: The passive form of Don't waste your time' is -
options: Let your time be not wasted.
Let your time not be wasted
Let your time be wasted.
Let not your time be wasted.
explain: Negative Imperative-এর নিয়ম: Let not + object + be + V3। তাই 'Let not your time be wasted' সঠিক।

q: The correct passive form of the sentence: ‘They elected him captain’ is -
options: He is elected captian by them
He was elected captain by them
He has been elected captain by them
Captain is elected him by them.
explain: এটি Factitive Object (Captain) যুক্ত বাক্য। এখানে মূল অবজেক্ট 'him' কে সাবজেক্ট করতে হয়। Past Indefinite অনুযায়ী 'was elected' বসবে।

q: The passive voice of : Post the letter is –
options: Let the letter be post.
Let the letter be posted.
Let the letter posted.
Let the letter post.
explain: Imperative sentence-এর নিয়ম: Let + object + be + V3 (posted)।

q: Salina was stitching a pant.
options: A pant was being stitch by Salina.
A pant was stitched by Salina.
A pant has been made by Salina.
A pant was being stitched by Salina.
explain: Past Continuous Tense-এর Passive নিয়ম: was/were + being + V3। 'A pant' এর সাথে 'was being stitched' বসবে।

q: 'We don't respect dishonest people is -
options: We are not respected by dishonest people
Dishonest people are not of our liking
Dishonest people are not respected by us
Dishonest people are not like us.
explain: Present Indefinite Negative-এর Passive: Object (Dishonest people) + are not + V3 (respected) + by us।

q: 'We read novels'
options: Novels is read by us.
Novels are read by us.
Novels are read by we.
Novels are being read by us.
explain: এখানে 'Novels' প্লুরাল অবজেক্ট, তাই Present Indefinite Passive-এ Plural verb 'are' বসবে।

q: 'Let me do the sum.'
options: Let the sum is to be done by me.
Let the sum done by me.
Let the sum being done by me.
Let the sum be done by me.
explain: 'Let' যুক্ত Active-এর Passive নিয়ম: Let + object (direct) + be + V3 + by + object (indirect)।

q: The passive form of the sentence 'do not open the door' is— .
options: let not the door be opened
let not the door open
let not the door be open
let not the door opened
explain: Negative Imperative-এর নিয়ম: Let not + object + be + V3 (opened)।

q: Let him do the sum. The passive form of the sentence is:
options: Let the sum be done by him.
The sum done by him.
He finished the sum.
It was he who done the sum
explain: 'Let him do...' এর Passive হবে 'Let the sum be done by him'।

q: The passive form of the sentence 'His sudden death shocked me' is:
options: I was shocked by his sudden death.
Note I was shocked to his sudden death.
I was shocked to know his sudden death.
I was shocked at his sudden death.
explain: 'Shocked' ভার্বের পর কোনো ঘটনায় অবাক হওয়া বোঝালে Preposition 'at' বসে।

q: Select the correct sentence----
options: The matter was informed of the police.
The matter had been informed of the police.
The police was informed of the matter.
The matter was informed to the police.
explain: কাউকে কোনো বিষয়ে জানানো হলে 'Person + was informed of the matter' স্ট্রাকচারটি সঠিক। তাই ৩ নম্বর অপশনটি প্রমিত।

q: ‘Please close the door. The passive form of this sentences is:
options: Let the door be closed.
You are requested to close the door.
The door is to be closed.
I request you to close the door.
explain: অনুরোধ বা 'Please' থাকলে Passive-এ 'You are requested to' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

q: 'Nobody believes a liar.' The correct passive form of the above sentence is:
options: A liar is never believed by anyone.
A liar should not be believed by anybody.
A liar is not believed by anybody.
A liar is believed by nobody.
explain: 'Nobody' থাকলে 'not... anybody' ব্যবহার করা ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভালো। Present Indefinite অনুযায়ী 'is not believed' সঠিক।

q: 'Tea is liked by common people'. This is an example of –
options: active voice
passive voice
quasi-passive voice
double passive voice
explain: বাক্যটিতে 'be (is) + V3 (liked)' এবং 'by' আছে, যা স্পষ্টভাবেই Passive Voice-এর বৈশিষ্ট্য।

q: 'He helped me do it'. The passive voice of the sentence is-
options: It was done by him to help me
I was helped by him to do it
It was helped me by him to do it
I was helped by him do it
explain: এটি Bare infinitive যুক্ত বাক্য। Passive-এ 'me' হয়ে যাবে 'I', এবং 'do' এর আগে 'to' বসবে।

q: The passive form of 'They have won the battle' is–
options: The battle have won by them
The battle had been won by them
The battle been won by them
The battle was won by them
explain: দ্রষ্টব্য: এখানে correct index ৩ (was won) দেওয়া আছে, যা মূলত 'The battle has been won' হওয়া উচিত ছিল। তবে অপশনে ভুল থাকলে নিকটতম সঠিক হিসেবে ৩ চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে।

q: 'He saw me do it is
options: I was seen do it by him
I was seen to do it by him
I was seen doing it by him
I was seen to doing it by him
explain: Active voice-এ 'saw' এর পর Bare infinitive থাকলে Passive-এ 'to + verb' বসে।

q: ‘I know him.' Is-
options: He is known by me
He is known to me
He was known to me
He has been known by me
explain: 'Know' ভার্বের পর Passive-এ 'to' বসে। Present Indefinite অনুযায়ী 'He is known to me'।

q: “The pill tastes bitter” is :
options: The pill is bitter when it is tasted.
The pill was bitter when it tasted.
The pill is bitter when it tastes.
The pill was bitter when it was tasted.
explain: এটি Quasi-passive বাক্য। এর Passive করার নিয়ম: Subject + be verb + adjective + when + it + be verb + V3।

q: He was helping me. The correct passive form is:
options: I was helped by him
I had been hepled by him
I have been helped by him
I was being helped by him.
explain: Past Continuous Tense-এর Passive স্ট্রাকচার: was/were + being + V3।
